caption: The drawing features a collection of decorative floral designs rendered in colored pencil or watercolor. At the top is a rectangular, scallop-edged section labeled "VALANCE FOR CURTAINS" containing a repeating arrangement of stylized flowers, leaves, and vines. The flowers feature shades of pink, red, blue, and yellow, with green and blue stems and leaves interwoven throughout. Below this section, on the lower half of the page, are four individual botanical motifs separated from each other by ample white space. These motifs display long, curving stems in patterned yellow, blue, or red dots and lines; each stem ends in a distinct, exotic flower. The leftmost flower is purple with touches of pink and blue, the second features pink fronds and a blue center, the third is large and green with a pink and yellow center and radiating pink lines, and the fourth includes two small hanging pink blossoms with yellow highlights. The overall composition is delicate and ornate, with emphasis on curving forms and varied, bright coloration.
title: Crewel Embroidery
